01

Receive a transfer

Scan a QR from the sending device, or open its transfer link in your trusted copy of this app.

Transfers without a password or wallet unlock automatically. Your secret stays hidden until you reveal it.

This transfer uses wallet protection. Approve signing only in your trusted copy.

Transfer received. Enter its password if one was set, then decrypt.
02

Scan & unlock

Bring your devices together.

Start the camera and point it at the QR. Your decrypted secret stays hidden until you reveal it.

Decrypted secret

Scanning never approves a wallet signature. Decryption is a separate action you control.

Finished transferring?

Secrets clear after 2 minutes without activity or 30 seconds in the background. Suspended pages clear expired secrets when they resume.

Clipboard history and device sync may retain copied secrets.

Encryption happens in this browser. The scanner is bundled and works offline. QR links open the hosted app; use a trusted copy to receive sensitive transfers.

Scanner integrity & source

Bundled scanner: jsQR 1.4.0 · Apache 2.0

Original CDN file, included locally. Nothing is downloaded at runtime:

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js

Bundled locally — no integrity check has run yet.

Original CDN file’s SHA-384 integrity fingerprint:

This is a content fingerprint, not a publisher’s digital signature. A match verifies the saved fingerprint; it does not certify safety or protect against a modified copy of this app.
